Definition: of Hebrew origin, the same as G4549; Saulus (i.e. Shaul), the Jewish name of Paul:--Saul.
BiblicalUsage: Saul is the Jewish name of Paul, and we meet it first at a stoning: the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul. He was consenting unto Stephen's death, and as for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women to prison.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Saul matters because the man who made havoc of the church became the man who built it. No persecutor is past the reach of the Lord who met him on the Damascus road.
